senses.gloss: m. (פָּרז) = b. h. פְּרָזִי, one residing in an open place, opp. מוקף.
units: Meg. 19ᵃ פ׳ בן יומו קרוי פ׳ one living in an open place for that one day (Purim) is called a paruz (bound to celebrate the fourteenth day of Adar, Esth. IX, 19); Y. ib. II, 73ᵇ top פ׳ הוא באותה שעה (not היה) he is a paruz for the time being.
